# VentureCite

> VentureCite is a Generative Engine Optimization (GEO) platform. It shows brands
> where AI search engines overlook, misread, or undersell them, then helps fix the
> pages and sources shaping every AI answer — so the brand gets cited accurately.

## What it does

- Measures brand visibility across AI answer engines (how, when, and whether you get cited).
- Surfaces where AI overlooks, misreads, or undersells your brand.
- Diagnoses which pages and sources are driving each AI answer.
- Guides the fixes to your owned content and third-party sources that move citations.

## Who it's for

Brands and marketing teams that want to control how AI search engines represent
and cite them, rather than leaving the narrative to chance.
